observations: body L19, L23: the items a) and b) are indented about one and a half times the indent of the paragraphs, as printed; their letters are italic.
body L17, L19, L33: the e of «Sed» (L17) prints like ø; specks over the u of «ortus» (L19) and over the space before «similibus» (L33) are not transcribed.
body L32-L33: in Nabod's list Albohali, Albumasar and Albubater are the Latin names of al-Khayyāṭ, Abū Ma‘shar and al-Ḥasan ibn al-Khaṣīb (notes 6 to 8).
notes_left L1: «τόποι» is set in the small Greek type.
notes_left L9: the hyphen of «XIV-XVI» measures 3.5 pt.
notes_right L2-L3: the title has «I. Schoneri», without the umlaut, and «Witenbergae», as printed.
notes_right L4-L10: the hyphens of «al-Khayyāṭ», «9-10», «28-30», «Al-Ḥasan», «al-Khaṣīb» and «32-33» measure 3.1 to 4.1 pt; «Chr» in L5 has no period, and the first e of «eunte» prints broken.
notes_right L7-L8: 28 ramaḍān 272 is 8 March 886 in the civil reckoning (7 March in the astronomers').
notes_right L12: the hyphen of «1230-1300» measures 2.8 pt.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
